description: Keep a preview permanently: claims a site made with publish_website into the user's GearHost account, so it becomes a free, permanent CloudSite at the same URL (no 72h expiry). Use when the user wants to keep their site. Requires signing in to GearHost: if they aren't signed in, they are asked to sign in or create a free account. Needs the preview's manage token (from publish_website). Returns structuredContent { status, url, claimed, expires_at, dashboard_url }.

token.description: The manage token of the preview to claim (keep it forever).

name: claim_website

setup.description: in_progress while the CloudSite is set up in the background (~2 min; the site keeps serving), then done.

title: Claim website to my account
